newsitem.title: FRANCE: OATs lose to Bunds on spreads as Jospin speaks.
newsitem.headline: OATs lose to Bunds on spreads as Jospin speaks.

text.p: 1343 GMT - OATs underperform Bunds then rebound slightly as French PM Jospin says public finances situation "serious". Reaffirms commitment to Emu on time says must go with economic solidarity. Says employment is "our priority". Jospin proposes four pct rise in SMIC national minimum wage. T-notes gain on Bunds. BTP/Bund spread narrows. Gilts lose earlier gains to Bunds ahead of national audit office report on government's assumptions underlying public finances.
Government bond spreads are calculated from Reuter benchmark bond price data and adjusted to take into account interest payment frequency.
